labels.description: Labels allow to create aliases inside mx_hal_def.h file like '<label>_init', '<label>_deinit' and '<label>_gethandle'. These aliases can be used on application side.

oneOf.description: Initialization code is generated but not called in peripheral initialization.

run_mode.title: RAM power supply in run mode

enable_flash_low_power_mode.title: Low power mode
enable_flash_low_power_mode.description: Enable the Flash memory low-power mode during Stop and Standby. Reduces current consumption but may increase wake-up latency.

enable_dead_battery_mode.title: Dead battery mode
enable_dead_battery_mode.description: Pull down CC1 and CC2 pins when UCPD is not active, to prevent floating states on the USB-C bus.

actions.message: This field is read-only because dead battery setting is configured in the UCPD1 panel. The PWR panel only displays live synchronized value from UCPD1.

enable_ucpd_config_retention.title: Retention in standby mode
enable_ucpd_config_retention.description: Retain UCPD pull-down resistor configuration in Standby mode to maintain USB-C state across low-power transitions.

actions.message: Can be configured only when the battery charging is enabled.

level_selection.title: Level
level_selection.description: Specifies the PVD level threshold. The indicated level values are extracted from datasheet's 'Embedded reset and power control block characteristics' typical values.

actions.message: Can be configured only when the PVD is enabled.
Can be configured only when the PVD is enabled.

level_selection.title: Level
level_selection.description: Specifies the AVD level threshold. The indicated level values are extracted from datasheet's 'Embedded reset and power control block characteristics' typical values.

actions.message: Can be configured only when the AVD is enabled.
Can be configured only when the AVD is enabled.
Can be configured only when the AVD or the PVD is enabled.

all_io.title: All I/O retention
all_io.description: Enable I/O retention mode for all I/Os except the I/Os support the standby functionality and PA13, PA14, PA15, and PB4.

jtag_io.title: JTAG I/O retention
jtag_io.description: Enable I/O retention mode for PA13, PA14, PA15, and PB4.

runtime.title: Applicative services
runtime.description: Allow to enter in different low power modes, exit low power modes and check in which low power mode the microcontroller is.

actions.message: Can be configured only when the runtime APIs are enabled.

lp_entry.title: Low power entry
lp_entry.description: Generate a function to enter the selected low-power mode using WFI or WFE instruction.

actions.message: Can be configured only when the runtime APIs are enabled.
Can be selected only when the selected low power mode is Sleep or Stop.
Can be configured only when the runtime APIs are enabled and low power entry is enabled.

lp_exit.title: Low power exit
lp_exit.description: Generate a function to restore clocks and peripherals after exiting the selected low-power mode.

actions.message: Can be configured only when the runtime APIs are enabled.
For optimal configuration, enable RCC module.

lp_check.title: Low power mode check
lp_check.description: Generate the function to check in which low power mode the microcontroller is.

actions.message: Can be configured only when the runtime APIs are enabled.
